meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 在 NanoClaw 软件从旧版迁移到新版后,Claude 会接手完成需要人工判断的收尾工作:先检查迁移报告,再帮你设置管理员账号、调整谁能使用机器人、把旧聊天记忆搬进新系统、核对容器设置,并处理你在旧版上做的自定义改动。
howto.when: 当你说出 “migrate from v1”“finish migration” 或 “v1 migration” 时触发。它只负责收尾:须先在终端运行过 `bash migrate-v2.sh`,否则 Claude 会让你先去运行。

say.text: 帮我完成 NanoClaw 从 v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾。
say.note: Claude 会先检查是否已运行过迁移脚本。

say.text: 迁移后帮我设置管理员账号,并选择谁能使用机器人。
say.note: 它会询问确认你的身份,然后设定访问策略。

say.text: 怎么处理我旧版的自定义代码和容器配置？
say.note: Claude 会检查你的 fork 改动并给出处理选项。

howto.what_en: Claude finishes a NanoClaw v1→v2 migration: checks the migration report, helps seed the owner, adjusts access policy, runs the memory migration for each group, reconciles container configs, and ports v1 fork customizations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'migrate from v1', 'finish migration', or 'v1 migration'. It starts only after `bash migrate-v2.sh` has run — otherwise Claude tells you to run that script first.

say_en.text: Help me finish the NanoClaw v1 to v2 migration.
say_en.note: Claude first checks whether the migration script ran.

say_en.text: Set me as owner and choose who can use the bot after migration.
say_en.note: It confirms your identity and asks about the access policy.

say_en.text: How do we handle my custom v1 code and container configs?
say_en.note: It lists your fork commits and checks container.json paths.
